d:
Kangres ke netritv vale indiya gathbandhan ne matdata suchi ke vishesh gahan punrikshan (esaaaeeaar) men kathit aniymittaon ko lekar mukhy chunav aayukt gyanesh kumar ke khilaf ramlila maidan men ravivar ko bari raili ki. ismen vipaksh ke pramukh dalon ke netaon ne hissa liya. raili men vipakshi netaon ne kendr sarkar aur chunav aayog par jamkar hamla bola. dekhie vipaksh ke march se lekar ramlila maidan men rahul gandhi ke sanbodhan tak bibisi sanvaddata dilanvaz pasha aur shad midhat ki ye graund riport.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
